Automatic spell checking is on for admin
steps: Open 'Coalition unveils election budget with tax cuts for families' for editing from desk 'Politics'

steps.script: (() => { const root = document.querySelector('[data-test-id="authoring"] [data-test-id="authoring-field"][data-test-value="body_html"] [contenteditable="true"]'); const block = root.querySelector('[data-block="true"]'); const walker = document.createTreeWalker(block, NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT); let last = null; while (walker.nextNode()) { last = walker.currentNode; } const range = document.createRange(); range.setStart(last, last.length); range.collapse(true); const sel = window.getSelection(); sel.removeAllRanges(); sel.addRange(range); })()

steps: Wait until [data-test-id="authoring"] [data-test-id="authoring-field"][data-test-value="body_html"] contains at least one [data-test-id="spellchecker-warning"]

steps.script: (() => { const el = document.querySelector('[data-test-id="authoring"] [data-test-id="authoring-field"][data-test-value="body_html"] [data-test-id="spellchecker-warning"]'); const r = el.getBoundingClientRect(); el.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('contextmenu', {bubbles: true, cancelable: true, clientX: r.left + 4, clientY: r.top + 4})); })()

cleanup.script: (() => { const b = [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-test-id="unsaved-changes-dialog"] button')].find((x) => x.textContent.trim().toLowerCase() === 'ignore'); if (b) { b.click(); } })()

notes: The menu opens on right-click (onContextMenu in SpellcheckerDecorator.tsx). capture.mjs has no right-click, so an evaluate step dispatches a 'contextmenu' MouseEvent on the first warning. Shows 'Suggestions' and 'Actions' (Add to dictionary, Ignore word). The steps put the caret at the end of the first body paragraph (DOM selection, which draft-js picks up) and type ' Most households recieved it calmly.' key by key; cleanup discards it with Ignore. Do not insert the text with execCommand: that does not mark the item dirty, so Close shows no prompt and the autosave is saved into the item.
